subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support approval-gated Claude CLI agent turns on paired nodes through this new configuration, protocol, and Plugin SDK surface?
rationale: The branch creates durable configuration, gateway transport, plugin runtime, and remote-execution contracts; the protected maintainer signal confirms that product and API ownership cannot be inferred by cleanup automation.

options.title: Sponsor the full surface
options.body: Accept the paired-node agent-run direction, then require live proof, conflict resolution, and complete upgrade and security review before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the user goal but redesign the patch to minimize or internalize public SDK, protocol, or configuration additions before proceeding.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave paired-node Claude catalog sessions view-only and close the implementation after documenting the product decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full surface
recommendation.body: Accept the paired-node agent-run direction, then require live proof, conflict resolution, and complete upgrade and security review before merge.
